title: Zakir Hussain Rose Garden, Chandigarh
content:
Zakir Hussain Rose Garden, Chandigarh - A Complete Travel Guide

Nestled in the heart of Chandigarh, Punjab the Zakir Hussain Rose Garden is Asia’s largest rose garden and one of the city’s most loved tourist attractions. Spread across 30 acres, this garden is home to over 1,600 varieties of roses and thousands of medicinal and ornamental plants. Whether you’re a nature lover, photographer, couple, or family traveler, Rose Garden Chandigarh is a must-visit spot.

Where is Rose Garden Located in Chandigarh ?

The Rose Garden is located in Sector 16, Chandigarh, close to major attractions like Sector 17 Plaza and Leisure Valley. Its central location makes it easily accessible from all parts of the city.

Rose Garden Chandigarh Timings

  • Opening Time: 6:00 AM
  • Closing Time: 10:00 PM
  • Best Time to Visit: Morning or evening
  •  Entry is free for all visitors.

Why is Rose Garden Chandigarh Famous ?

Asia’s largest collection of roses

  • Medicinal plants like bel, neem, ashwagandha
  •  Annual Rose Festival (February)
  •  Perfect photography & picnic spot
  •  Romantic atmosphere for couples

Rose Festival Chandigarh (Major Attraction)

The Rose Festival is held every year in February or March and attracts tourists from across India.
Highlights include:

  • Flower competitions
  • Cultural performances
  • Food stalls
  • Live music & folk dance

This is the best time to experience the garden at its peak bloom.

Things to Do at Rose Garden Chandigarh

  • Take a peaceful walk among roses
  • Click Instagram-worthy photos
  • Enjoy morning yoga & jogging
  • Spend family picnic time
  • Attend seasonal flower shows

Travel Tips for Visitors

  •  Visit during rose season for best experience
  •  Carry water & sun protection
  •  Follow garden rules, don’t pluck flowers
  •  Ideal for families, couples & solo travelers
excerpt: Zakir Hussain Rose Garden Chandigarh is more than just a flower garden-it’s a peaceful escape, a visual delight, and one of the city’s most iconic attractions. With its vast collection of roses, well-maintained walking paths, and lively Rose Festival, it offers a refreshing experience for tourists of all ages.
